units.source_text: 浮舟平日只是怅望云山，但觉日长难暮。

en.t: On ordinary days, Ukifune only gazed wistfully toward the clouded mountains and felt that the day was long and slow to end.

units.source_text: 但今天匂亲王生怕日暮之后即将别去，看得寸阴如金，浮舟同情于他，也觉得转瞬日色已暮。

en.t: But today Prince Niou dreaded that he would have to leave once evening came, and treasured every moment like gold; sympathizing with him, Ukifune too felt that dusk had arrived in an instant.

units.source_text: 在这昼长人静的春天，匂亲王细看浮舟，但觉妩媚可爱，毫无瑕疵，

en.t: In this quiet springtime, when the days were long and no one disturbed them, Prince Niou looked closely at Ukifune and found her charming, lovely, and without the least flaw,

units.source_text: 真所谓“相看终日厌时无”。

en.t: just as the saying goes, one could gaze all day and never grow tired.

units.source_text: 其实浮舟的容貌毕竟逊于二女公子。

en.t: In truth, however, Ukifune's beauty was still inferior to that of the Second Princess.

units.source_text: 而比起年华鼎盛的六女公子来，相差更远。

en.t: Compared with the Sixth Princess, who was in the full bloom of youth, the difference was even greater.

units.source_text: 只因匂亲王爱她入迷，便把她看成盖世无双的美人。

en.t: It was only because Prince Niou was so infatuated with her that he saw her as an unrivaled beauty.

units.source_text: 浮舟也一向认为薰大将是盖世无双的美男子，如今看到这风流俊俏的匂亲王，

en.t: Ukifune too had always thought General Kaoru an unmatched handsome man, but now that she saw the elegant and handsome Prince Niou,
she realized that General Kaoru was far beneath him.

units.source_text: 匂亲王取过笔砚来，随意书写。

en.t: Prince Niou took up brush and inkstone and wrote freely as he pleased.

units.source_text: 他的戏笔非常美妙，绘画也十分生动，使得这青年女子倾心爱慕。

en.t: Even his playful brushwork was wonderfully beautiful, and his drawings were full of life, causing the young woman to love and admire him wholeheartedly.

units.source_text: 画罢，他对浮舟说道：“如果我不能随心所欲地前来与你相聚，

en.t: When he had finished drawing, he said to Ukifune, If I cannot come whenever I wish to be with you,

units.source_text: 这期间你可看看这幅画。”

en.t: then in the meantime you may look at this picture.

units.source_text: 画中所写的是一对美貌男女互相偎傍的情景。

en.t: The picture showed a beautiful man and woman leaning close against each other.

units.source_text: 他指着这幅画说：“但愿我俩常常如此。”

en.t: Pointing to the picture, he said, May the two of us always be like this.
After saying this, he shed tears and recited a poem:
